newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Severe storm approaches Bangladesh coast.
newsitem.headline: Severe storm approaches Bangladesh coast.

text.p: Fishermen have been warned not to put to sea as weather officials said a severe storm brewing in the Bay of Bengal may hit the Bangladesh coast by early Monday,
The storm, with a maximum speed of 160 kph (98 mph), was located 790 km (487 miles) southwest of Chittagong port city at 3 a.m. (2100 GMT) on Sunday, a Storm Warning Centre bulletin said.
It said coastal officials had been advised to hoist danger signals and urged fishermen not to leave port.
The officials warned of rough seas and high tides.
A tropical storm on Friday lashed northern Bogra district killing six people and injuring 100, police said on Sunday.
